title: Fractal Uncertainty and Quantitative Uniqueness for the Fourier Bessel Transform
summary: We establish quantitative uniqueness and a fractal uncertainty principle for the Fourier Bessel transform. In arbitrary dimension, we prove a quantitative uniqueness estimate on relatively dense sets for functions whose Fourier Bessel transforms decay according to a quasi-analytic weight.
